svg.title: Iran: a governor on the effect
svg.desc: A diagram of effects for Iran's cyber calibration, drawn as one balancing loop with a single branch. Cyber provocation raises the risk of a response Iran cannot absorb; that risk raises restraint and reversibility, by the state's choice; and restraint lowers provocation again. One edge lowers where the others raise, so the loop is balancing, marked B and read clockwise: it is the inferred governor that holds the effect under the level the state cannot afford. Drawn in grey, meaning a sourced effect on a branch with no evidenced return: proxies and hacktivist fronts, which raise provocation outside the state's direct control, complicating the calibration during the 2025 exchanges; Albania, a state-attributed crossing, is the clearest case in the record where the inferred governor appears to have failed. An increase in cyber provocation raises the risk of a response Iran cannot absorb. An increase in the risk of a response Iran cannot absorb raises restraint and reversibility, by human intervention. An increase in restraint and reversibility lowers cyber provocation, by human intervention. An increase in proxies and hacktivist fronts raises cyber provocation, by human intervention.
svg.text: Iran: a governor on the effect
One balancing loop, marked B, with proxies as the branch that complicates it
One balancing loop: provocation raises the risk of a response Iran cannot absorb, that risk raises restraint, and restraint lowers the provocation again.
The single lowering edge makes the loop balancing, marked B: it holds the effect under the level the state cannot afford.
Proxies and hacktivist fronts hang off in grey, raising provocation outside the state's direct control and complicating the calibration in 2025.
Albania, state-attributed, is the clearest case in the record where the governor itself appears to have failed.
natural effect, same direction as the movement of the cause
human intervention, same direction as the movement of the cause
human intervention, opposite direction to the movement of the cause
grey: sourced effect on a branch with no evidenced return
